newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: C&W Manila unit says 1st half net up 4.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: C&W Manila unit says 1st half net up 4.4 pct.

text.p: Eastern Telecommunications Philippines Inc (ETPI), an affiliate of Cable & Wireless, said on Friday its net income for the first half of the year rose 4.4 percent to 253 million pesos from 242.3 million a year-ago.
ETPI vice-chairman Luis Sison said in a statement net revenues from international operations rose to 792 million pesos for the first half of the year from 686 million.
Sison said the firm's operating income rose 5.3 percent to 332 million pesos in the first six months from 315 million.
The company is an international gateway facility operator.
